items.title: Surge in networks scans targeting Cisco ASA devices raise concerns
items.description: Large network scans have been targeting Cisco ASA devices, prompting warnings from cybersecurity researchers that it could indicate an upcoming flaw in the products. [...]

items.title: 'MostereRAT' Malware Blends In, Blocks Security Tools
items.description: A threat actor is using a sophisticated EDR-killing malware tool in a campaign to maintain long-term, persistent access on Windows systems.

items.title: Salesloft Breached via GitHub Account Compromise
items.description: The breach kickstarted a massive supply chain attack that led to the compromise of hundreds of Salesforce instances through stolen OAuth tokens.

items.title: Hackers steal 3,325 secrets in GhostAction GitHub supply chain attack
items.description: A new supply chain attack on GitHub, dubbed 'GhostAction,' has compromised 3,325 secrets, including PyPI, npm, DockerHub, GitHub tokens, Cloudflare, and AWS keys. [...]

items.title: Signal adds secure cloud backups to save and restore chats
items.description: Signal has introduced a new opt-in feature that helps users create end-to-end encrypted backups of their chats, allowing them to restore messages even if their phones are damaged or lost. [...]

items.title: Lovesac confirms data breach after ransomware attack claims
items.description: American furniture brand Lovesac is warning that it suffered a data breach impacting an undisclosed number of individuals, stating their personal data was exposed in a cybersecurity incident. [...]

items.title: Sports streaming piracy service with 123M yearly visits shut down
items.description: ​Calcio, a large piracy sports streaming platform with more than 120 million visits in the past year, was shut down following a collaborative effort by the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE) and DAZN. [...]
